notes.title: "PowerWash Adventure" PC Version is Now Releasing on Steam!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]"PowerWash Adventure PC" launched on Steam![/b][/h2]
Independent immersive flushing game [b]"PowerWash Adventure"[/b] today (December 13th) officially opened for sale, Steam platform debut special price of 10% off, ultra-low price to experience the fun of immersive flushing, the pleasure of super decompressive rinsing at wil, quickly pick up the water gun "rinse" as you please! In PowerWash Adventure, you can literally get your hands on the exhilarating feeling of rinsing and relieving pressure. The operation of the game is super simple: use the high-pressure water gun to flush items to clean. As a casual and stress relieving rinsing simulation game, you can start and end it at any time without gameplay pressure. We also offer a variety of immersive themes: weightless space, cleaning workshop, and a variety of animals on the prairie!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763957/6e8392b74c5a293635dfb8defeb77438d7f02036.png[/img]
[h2][b]Offers a variety of scenarios and characters[/b][/h2]
In "PowerWash Adventure" You're a city cleaner protecting the the environment, you're an astronaut in space rinsing a space station, or you can be the archaeologist rinsing a statue of Anubis in the Sahara Desert. Richly themed levels and expansion DLCs allow you to experience the multiverse!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763957/5f0e6a9be73f6847a47c826aa273229e53421d96.png[/img]
[h2][b]No pressure, just flush![/b][/h2]
The game's interactive mechanism is as simple as picking up a high-pressure water gun and rinsing the items in the scene to make them clean. Players can configure different nozzles for the water gun to feel the different spraying feeling and enjoy the immersive rinsing process. You can start and finish the game at any time, so you won't feel the game stress. We also provide a handy little helper to help you easily find hidden stains and unlock 100% of the rinsing progress, so say goodbye to compulsive disorder!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763957/d48488768495b271c301c00280058d5ee85e9626.png[/img]

[b]A message from the development team:[/b]
PowerWash Adventure" is currently in the early stage, we are aware that the product still has a number of imperfections, we hope that if you encounter any problems during the play process, please provide feedback with us in the community, and we will carefully listen to the suggestions of each and every player. 

Discord：https://discord.com/invite/P4quCzAD2g

Kind Regards,
PowerWash Adventure Team
